copy.curiosityHook: Cut off from help on a desolate highway, how can a team of teenagers outlast a foe that seems completely impossible to beat?
copy.description: Stranded on an empty stretch of road after their bus breaks down, a squad of high school athletes finds themselves cornered by a lethal adversary they cannot hope to defeat.
copy.vibeSummary: Tense, contained horror paced with steady suspense and moderate emotional weight, built for an engaged night in with friends.
copy.whyWatch: Delivering lean, suspenseful creature-feature dread, this isolated survival horror pits a vulnerable group against an unrelenting predatory force in a desperate standoff.

allowedMaterial: high school athletic team stranded on a deserted road
excludedMaterial: identity or lore of the creature beyond what is in the overview
